title: Reviewing Adequacy of Statutory Levers in Children and Young Persons Act
what_it_is: Reviewing Adequacy of Statutory Levers in Children and Young Persons Act

sections.label: UPLIFT taskforce for disadvantaged students
sections.summary: The Uplifting Pupils in Life and Inspiring Families Taskforce was set up to enhance support for disadvantaged students.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Uplifting Pupils in Life and Inspiring Families Taskforce (UPLIFT) has been set up to enhance support for disadvantaged students.

sections.label: CYPA invoked for family harm
sections.summary: Where children are harmed by family members or other adults, the CYPA would be invoked, and reviewing it is not UPLIFT's focus.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: There may be instances, of course, where children are prevented from doing well educationally due to harm inflicted by family members or other adults and, in those instances, the CYPA would be invoked.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: However, as the provisions of CYPA are adequate for its purpose, reviewing it will not be UPLIFT's focus.

sections.label: Three areas of focus
sections.summary: Three areas of focus were preliminarily identified: students' motivation and resilience, long-term absenteeism, and outreach to parents of disadvantaged families.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In that respect, we have preliminarily identified the three areas of focus, which are, first, to improve and strengthen these students' motivation and resilience; second, getting to the root of the underlying reasons of long-term absenteeism in our primary and secondary schools, as failure to attend school is a common factor among underperforming students; and third, strengthening engagement and outreach to parents of disadvantaged families.

sections.label: Community partners' many-helping-hands role
sections.summary: The task force is looking at a many-helping-hands approach with community, self-help and voluntary welfare groups participating.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: In that respect, community partners have a big role to play.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, the task force is looking to see how we can have a many-helping-hands approach and how community, self-help groups, voluntary welfare groups can all participate in this.

sections.label: Widening CYPA ambit not ruled out
sections.summary: On widening the ambit of CYPA, it will not be ruled out looking at whether statutory levers are needed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The Member asked then whether or not it would be necessary to widen the ambit of CYPA.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: We will not rule out looking at whether we need any statutory levers.

sections.label: Statutory levers as last resort
sections.summary: The general approach is, as far as possible, to use statutory levers as a last resort.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Two, the general approach is, as far as possible, to use statutory levers as a last resort.

sections.label: Holistic study of options
sections.summary: The speaker says the matter must be looked at holistically and a wide range of options will be studied.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: You do have to look at it holistically and we will study a wide range of options.
